source_review.correction: Scan the full adjacent nonblank region, using blank rows or blank transcript scrollbar rows as boundaries. Strict validation rejects malformed rows instead of ignoring them.
source_review.follow_up: No remaining actionable findings in the bounded source-only review; reviewer ran no validation and made no edits.

fixture.timing: Final measured capture is not an atomic observation of the earlier failed stage read. Both are retained with distinct provenance.

implementation.recheck: Repeat measured validation after optional staged hook immediately before the existing one Enter; preserve captures on failure
implementation.safety: No typing of placeholder, no blind Enter, no retry of Enter, no parser/footer policy changes or message-body delivery through tmux
